## SMS Gateway Command Interface

**Flow Number:** 514
**Domain:** SMS/Notifications (500-599)

### Purpose
Authorize and normalize inbound SMS. Answer HELP index locally. Dispatch all other commands to flow 515 via `sms/command/dispatch`. Queue replies from `sms/command/reply` onto `sms/gateway/command/send` (sole reply path).
